name: totp-2fa
title: Optional TOTP two-factor authentication for user accounts
description: Add opt-in TOTP two-factor authentication to user accounts: enable/disable from the account settings page with password confirmation, QR-code enrollment of an authenticator app, backup codes, and a second verification step during sign-in. Powered by the better-auth twoFactor plugin (TOTP only, no email/SMS OTP, no trust-device, no admin-side reset).
creator: zzx
